review_basis: Official FIA archive-level disposition of the four 2024 Belgian pit-lane-speeding labels advertised only as recalled records with no live PDF or recoverable successor. These are single-coded pending-human records, not independent review, and no decision outcome is imputed.

fields.review_notes: Official FIA archive reviewed. Recalled Document 14 identifies a first Car 3 pit-lane-speeding infringement but exposes no PDF or successor. Retained as unavailable provenance and excluded without imputing a session, sanction, or outcome; pending independent review.
